    The odd quotients of even A in characteristic two (Appendix B) #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex: "For the odd quotient of A_{2n} with period r, … If r ≤ 2n − 1, retain the first (r+1)/2 levels. The top paths of the resulting even-A tree have degree r, go to reflected vertices, and increase the repetition coordinate by r. They are nonzero radical endomorphisms at every quotient object. Thus r > 2n − 1. A path from τv to v starts and ends at the same level and has degree d ≡ 2 modulo r, whereas d ≤ 2n − 1 < r. Again no degree at least three is possible."

    This file: the second part (a_even_long). A row of degree m + 1 ≥ 3 lifts to a path of length 2 + n r ≥ 2 + r > 2n, which vanishes in Π(A_{2n}) (ASort.long_mem); in characteristic two the all-one coefficients are the signed ones, so it gives the zero class (phiL_eq_zero_of_mem).
